tools.name: update
tools.description: Read or change the project To Do list (.claude/todo-panel.md) the user sees in a side pane. Answers with the current list; call with no ops to read it. Pending Decisions: questions only the user can answer (blocks = the task id it holds up). Backlog: work agreed but not done, at task level (never single steps), in the order you recommend, each with a one-line why for its place. Remove an item once done or decided. Only use this when the project has a To Do list or the user asked to set one up.
